hotspots.label: Hundred grid
hotspots.description: A 10-by-10 grid where each lit cube is one hundredth — 30 lit cubes are 30 hundredths or 0.3.
hotspots.positionHint: The square grid of 100 small cubes, some lit amber.
hotspots.function: Visualizes decimals as parts of a hundred.

hotspots.label: Decimal point
hotspots.description: The decimal point separates the whole-number part from the fraction part.
hotspots.positionHint: The dot on the place-value strip between the ones and tenths columns.
hotspots.function: Marks where whole numbers end and tenths begin.

hotspots.label: Place columns
hotspots.description: Tenths, hundredths, and thousandths are the place columns after the point.
hotspots.positionHint: The labeled columns to the right of the decimal point.
hotspots.function: Give each decimal digit its place-based value.

visualStyleNotes: Fractions And Ratios, Math palette, Anatomy Atelier bar: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props. A clean 10×10 grid of small cubes beside a place-value strip, with a fill slider. Soft neutral studio light, no rim-light glow, no bloom, no emissive. Strong saturated color reserved for the small flat hotspot dots (amber / coral / molecular-green from the Math palette). Specimen-quality clean-3D, not cartoon, not cluttered.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0 everywhere. Grid cubes: warm paper white (roughness ~0.5); lit cubes: warm amber (roughness ~0.45). Place-value strip: warm paper with ink-grey column labels and an ink decimal point. Fill slider: soft warm-grey rail with amber knob. Mat: soft warm-grey (roughness ~0.85). No emissive channels anywhere — highlights handled by app runtime UI.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: decimals as parts of a hundred — a 10×10 cube grid with a fill slider and a place-value strip showing tenths/hundredths.

GEOMETRY: Hundred grid: 100 small cubes in 10 rows × 10 columns (spacing ~0.1) at x ≈ −0.9, y ≈ 0.25. Fill slider at the front controls how many cubes light (0..100), and the label shows the decimal (0.0..1.0). Place-value strip: a floating panel at x ≈ 0.7 showing '0 . 3 0' with column labels ones/tenths/hundredths under each digit. A mode toggle switches the strip between tenths and hundredths display.

LAYERS (toggleable): (1) grid + lit cubes; (2) place-value strip; (3) fraction-label plate.

CAMERA: head-on, slightly above, from +z frames grid and strip; labels legible. Budget 7-12k triangles. Named nodes: GridCubes, LitCubes, FillSlider_Knob, PlaceValueStrip, DecimalPoint, ColumnLabels, FractionPlate. All labels are hotspot dots in the app layer.
